page.overview:
Who is T'Shen Kovil?

Captain T'Shen Kovil was a male Human Starfleet officer who lived during the mid-23rd century and commanded the .

In 2256, Captain Kovil perished when the Gagarin came under attack from six Klingon ships and was lost with all hands, following a failed rescue attempt by the . ()
